newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in slow late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in slow late trading.

text.p: Indonesian SIR20 rubber offer prices were stable in slow late trading on Wednesday amid thin buying interest, traders said.
"It's been so quiet with no fresh deals heard," one trader in Palembang said.
Traders said there were bids for the benchmark SIR20 August shipment at 46.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, but traders refused to sell as the price was considered unprofitable.
Offer prices were at 46.75 fob Medan, at 46.25 fob Padang, at 46.50 fob Surabaya and at 46.00 fob Jambi and Pontianak.
